name: Kingdom of Denmark
alt: Denmark with Greenland and the Faroe Islands

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Denmark (1814-1940)
predecessors.text: Denmark, as Cliopatria's last pre-occupation shape (the Danish lands, 1936-39 about 53,000 km2)

ledger.x: May 1945: Denmark is liberated and the Danish state governs again from Copenhagen.

certainty.note: The land border with Germany (68 km) is the 1920 plebiscite line ('On 10 July 1920, Northern Schleswig was recovered by Denmark'); the coasts and the Greenland ice margin are surveyed or natural lines.
